slides.title:
Your most valuable asset
isn't the configuration.
The config is recoverable
slides.body:
Backup. Device. Repository.
Rebuild it in a week
of unpleasant work.

slides.title: What isn't
steps: Why the timers on that one link are different.
Why a route-map excludes a prefix that looks like it belongs.
Why one site runs older firmware, and has for *three years*.

slides.title: Each has a reason
slides.body:
Usually a good one.
Arrived at during an outage
nobody wants to *repeat*.

slides.title: What happens
slides.body:
A new engineer corrects an
inconsistency — and reintroduces
a problem solved *years ago*.

slides.title: Not access control
slides.body:
You can't prevent it that way.
Make the reason *travel*
with the configuration.

slides.title:
The strangest thing in
your running config —
slides.body:
can anyone but its author
explain it?

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
